message.content:
A magazine cover titled "TEMPO" in large, light-brown capital letters features a central illustration of a man from the chest up. The man, with dark hair and wearing a tan collared shirt, leans his head into his right hand, which is pressed against his forehead. His eyes are closed, and his mouth is slightly open. In his left hand, he holds a pair of thin-rimmed glasses near his chin. Floating above his head is a small, red, coiled dragon with its mouth open.

To the left, bold red text reads "REKLAMASI TUJUH KELILING" above smaller black text. A red vertical bar runs along the left edge. The top of the cover contains the black text "ANGGOTA DEWAN DI PANAMA PAPERS". Below the main title, the dates "11-17 APRIL 2016" appear. A logo with the number "45" in colorful geometric shapes is in the top left corner. A barcode and the price "RP 39.500" are at the bottom left. The background is a flat, pale-yellow color.
